title: Widower's Common Relics
description: Widower's Common Relics — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Tilles the Sellout

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 4 Widow Maker's Common Spiked Wristband Relics from within The Widower's Nest and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Quest Reward: 5 King's Coins

Return to: Tilles the Sellout

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Widower's Nest

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect 4 Widow Maker's Common Spiked Wristband Relics from within The Widower's Nest and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Offer:

Krelgor's Used Relics: We Buy Your Relics!
WANTED: 4 Widow Maker's Common Spiked Wristband Relics. Willing to pay King's Coin for Relics at a great rate! Contact Tilles the Sellout for more info.

Turn-in:

You have a knack for finding these Relics. I'll contact the person who posted the ad on your behalf.

Objectives:

  • Widower's Common Relics ×4

Level range: 20–45
